stories.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
stories.body: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.

stories.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
stories.body: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

stories.title: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
stories.body: Another 309 people are injured in the attack on the airport, which come days after Yemen's Houthis said they had struck it.

stories.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
stories.body: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.

stories.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
stories.body: Roofs were ripped off buildings after Isaias barrelled into the US on Friday evening, before it weakened to a post-tropical cyclone.

stories.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
stories.body: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.

stories.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
stories.body: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

stories.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
stories.body: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

stories.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
stories.body: The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - want electoral reforms ahead of crucial state elections.

stories.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
stories.body: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

stories.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
stories.body: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

stories.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
stories.body: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

stories.title: US country music star Ella Langley cancels show due to 'security threat'
stories.body: Police say they checked the concert venue in Tulsa, Oklahoma but "could not find any threat".

stories.title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
stories.body: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.

stories.title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
stories.body: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.

stories.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he would not watch it
stories.body: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

stories.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
stories.body: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

stories.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
stories.body: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

stories.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
stories.body: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

stories.title: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
stories.body: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.
